description.value: Bridgemans Bistro sits at the water's edge at Mill Bay Marina on the Saanich Inlet, serving West Coast-inspired lunch and dinner menus built around locally sourced seafood and regional ingredients. Every table takes in views of the inlet and Mount Baker, with local beers on tap and Cowichan Valley wines rounding out the experience. The no-reservations, first-come-first-served policy means touring cyclists can walk in without advance planning.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bridgemans Bistro is an active, walk-in-only waterfront restaurant at Mill Bay Marina, with West Coast-inspired menus, local beer and Cowichan Valley wine, and a no-reservations policy; the phone number and primary address match OSM exactly. The site mentions Free WIFI as a marina-wide amenity but does not confirm it extends to the bistro, and makes no mention of bike parking, racks, washrooms, or other cycling-specific infrastructure, so those fields are null per absence-of-evidence rules. Two concerns warrant flagging: the site footer shows a different postal code (V8H 1H9) than the main content and OSM (V0R 2P1), and OSM's closing time of 21:00 conflicts with the website's stated 8:00 pm (20:00) closing for all days.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: main website content and OSM both show V0R 2P1, but the site footer consistently displays V8H 1H9 — the correct postal code should be verified against Canada Post records.
OSM closing time of 21:00 conflicts with the website's stated closing time of 8:00 pm (20:00) for all days of the week.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established waterfront restaurant at a marina on a popular Vancouver Island cycling corridor; locally sourced food, no-reservations walk-in policy, and a scenic setting make it a natural and useful stop for touring cyclists.
